apps.localizedDescription: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS. No ads, background playback, video and audio downloads, SponsorBlock, Picture in Picture, player gestures and deep interface customization.
apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.36.6 | YTKACE 0.9.3 | YTKACE_0.9.3_YouTube_21.36.6

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated for YouTube 21.36.6
• Added a toggle to remove the Save button from Shorts

Fixed:
• Fixed the feed lagging while scrolling with Remove Shorts, Products, Mixes or Community Posts on
• Fixed the You tab moving to the end of the tab bar after changing other tabs
• Fixed hold to speed staying stuck at the held speed after letting go
• Fixed the Save button in Shorts overlapping the other buttons
• Fixed Block Premium Prompts stopping community post images from opening
• Fixed Clear Cache saying there was nothing to clear while YouTube's video cache kept growing

YouTube 21.36.6 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_0.9.3_YouTube_21.36.6.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_0.9.3_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
